Definition: Does the government maintain a digital address register?
Comments: Kenya has a National Addressing System of Kenya (NASK) framework led by the Communications Authority, with policy/standards and plans to develop a national database and implement at county level, indicating under development rather than fully deployed registry.

Definition: Is the register integrated with the population register?
Comments: Civil registration data is captured into IPRS/National Population Register but UN CRVSID describes weak real-time updating mechanisms; hence partial integration between CRVS and population register.

Definition: Is the population register integrated with the civil register?
Comments: UN CRVSID and World Bank ID4D note that civil registration data (birth/death records) feeds into IPRS but lacks effective real-time/automatic update mechanisms, implying partial rather than full integration.

Definition: Are all non-citizens allowed to be included in the register?
Comments: Official IPRS/Maisha description states it provides comprehensive population data on all Kenyans and foreigners resident in Kenya; UN CRVSID case study notes registration systems include aliens and refugees, implying non-citizens can be included broadly.
